sampling: Original raw RGBA, nearest WebGL sampling using the actual viewport and physical origin; native hover shade is blended before the native join sprite. Bitmap/Unihex text uses original advances and quarter-intensity shadows.
nativeData: The test LevelSummary supplies fixed compatible-world title, ID and description; lastPlayed=-1 disables date formatting. Parent list data is allocated without running world loading or opening real saves. The original WorldListEntry and AbstractSelectionList renderer paint every expected pixel.
webSemantics: Ten standard shadcn Item exports, refs, HTML props and asChild composition. Default native appearance/size only. Header/footer/action placement and custom media are web compositions. Direct semantic link/button activation reuses the original click sound; passive selection stays silent and custom asChild components keep their own audio.
scope: 180 compatible-world row cases: six ASCII/Chinese/Japanese/Korean/mixed/overflow contents, normal/body-hover/icon-hover/selected/focused states, two backgrounds and GUI scales1–3. Whole-row links and buttons match all180 cases; passive div aliases match the108 non-hover cases. Additional84 Label cases through standalone ItemTitle and108 Separator cases through ItemSeparator. Arbitrary content, custom media, locked/incompatible world states, rich composed layouts, other glyphs and raster environments remain outside this exact matrix.
